warn.detail: on the pre-identified collapse fold expert A's error is 3249.2 against B's 86.7, so the optimum sits near g=1. P0L1 held 0.593, close to the fitted alpha of 0.65; the sequence gate went to 0.295 with 45.3% of origins below 0.3. Its correlation with g* is the same as P0L1's (0.381 vs 0.377), so the failure is in the level it chooses, not in its ranking.

FreshRetailNet is genuinely recovered for the first time on this axis: -0.506% for P0L1 becomes +2.648% with a CI clear of zero, better than P0L1 on 3/3 folds. The stop rule was frozen to require this AND four other things, and three of those failed.

the per-series relative metric explodes where a series' P0L1 error is near zero (favorita -186%, uci -2.7e6). The normalized-MSE primary is unaffected; this is why the scale-contradiction check fired and it is reported rather than dropped.
fails to beat P0L1 on at least 3 of 4
severe temporal fold reversal on 3 datasets
no existing TEST was scored and no new dataset was used
the seed policy was frozen before training as one canonical seed plus a reproducibility rerun, matching P0L1's single-seed structure; no seed was retried after seeing results
